text:
Alex: late-night bug fixing — need recs for cozy books + dumb shows to unwind. Prefer short books or comfort TV.
Maria: The House in the Cerulean Sea — cozy, pure warm-blanket energy. For dumb comfort show: Schitt's Creek or Brooklyn 99. :heart: 
Sam: If you want short sci-fi: ‘Story of Your Life’ (Ted Chiang) — quick but hits. For calming nonsense: The Great British Bake Off.
Jin: For genuinely short & sweet: Eleanor Oliphant (not actually 100 pages, but very readable). Show rec: Ted Lasso for max serotonin.
Casey: If you want audio, try LeVar Burton Reads — perfect for 30-min unwind. +1 to GBBO.
Oliver: Also pop on a lo-fi playlist (low volume). Quick comic/graphic novel rec: Mythos — great quick read between bugs. :book:
Luna: Fiction rec: The Night Circus if you want dreamy late-night vibes. Show: Only Murders in the Building — light mystery + jokes.
Alex: Nice. Anyone got one-sentence elevator pitch for House in the Cerulean Sea? Trying to sell it to my partner.
Maria: "A found-family story with magical kids and ridiculous bureaucracy." :laughing:
Sam: Quick poll — what to watch tonight? React with an emoji: GBBO = :cookie:, Ted Lasso = :soccer:, Only Murders = :detective:
Casey: :cookie:
Jin: :soccer:
Luna: :detective:
Alex: Going GBBO + reading Cerulean Sea. Thanks all. Here’s a tiny reading list I use when I only have 15–30 mins: `https://example.com/5-min-reads`
Maria: GIF: :cozy_cat: (very professional)
Sam: If anyone wants a 3-song pre-bed playlist I can drop one.
Alex: Please do. Low energy, no heavy drums.
Sam: Dropping: 1) Sufjan Stevens — Mystery of Love, 2) Agnes Obel — Fuel to Fire, 3) Nick Drake — Northern Sky.
Alex: Perfect. Signing off to bake and read, see you in the AM. :wave:
